name: oryh-ai-client
description: ORYH-native AI client foundation and DeepSeek Harness integration packages.

scripts.build: node scripts/check-dsh-patch.mjs && pnpm --filter @oryh/dsh-host... build && pnpm --filter @oryh/ai-client-workspace build && node scripts/generate-dsh-remote.mjs && pnpm --filter @oryh/dsh-client build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm --recursive run typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.server:p0: pnpm --filter @oryh/server-lab build && pnpm --filter @oryh/server-lab test && pnpm --filter @oryh/server-lab probe:docker
